name: Nakagusuku (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakagusuku village emblem in green, red and blue: a green disc bearing a red and blue stylised castle gate.
history: Municipal flag of Nakagusuku, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1979.

features.role: Nakagusuku village emblem — a green disc bearing a red and blue stylised castle gate
